stops.name: Parque Natural de Urbasa-Andía
stops.detail: The Natural Park of Urbasa-Andía is a protected natural space of the Foral Community of Navarra, Spain, situated to the north of the meringency of Estella. It was declared a natural park on 27 February 1997. It has an extension of 21 408 ha and is mainly occupied by beech and mountain pasture. The latitude of this place lies between 42 ° 35 ′ and 42 ° 52 ′ N and its height above sea level. It is between 835 and 1492 metres and corresponds to the Beriaren summit at St. Donato's, in the Sierra de Andia. The existing vegetation is of great diversity. Both sierra are true and their property corresponds to the Fatal Community of Navarra.
